description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for verifying the compatibility and correctness of reftables between Git and JGit. It sets environment variables, checks prerequisites, defines test functions, and executes a series of tests involving repository creation, commits, and reference comparisons between Git and JGit implementations.

methods.name: test_commit_jgit
methods.description: Creates a file, stages it with jgit add, and commits it with a commit message.

methods.name: test_same_refs
methods.description: Compares the references of the local git repository and the jgit repository to ensure they are identical.

methods.name: test_same_ref
methods.description: Compares the revision hash of a specific reference between git and jgit to ensure they match.

methods.name: test_same_reflog
methods.description: Compares the reflog entries of a specified reference between git and jgit.
